description: This is a Java test class for parsing Unicode emoji data, specifically testing the UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser functionality with various emoji data inputs, including grouping, skin tones, tags, and descriptions.

classes.name: UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser's ability to parse emoji data from text input, including grouping, skin tones, tags, and descriptions.

methods.name: parseFromString
methods.description: Utility method to create a temporary file, write the input string to it, and parse it using UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser.

methods.name: testSimpleEmojis
methods.description: Tests parsing of simple emoji lines and verifies output emojis and positions.

methods.name: testParseQualifiedAndFully
methods.description: Tests parsing of qualified and unqualified emoji lines and verifies output emojis.

methods.name: testGrouping
methods.description: Tests parsing of grouped emoji data with categories and subcategories, verifying grouping labels and positions.

methods.name: testSkinToneVariants
methods.description: Tests parsing of skin tone variants and verifies the output emojis and their variants.

methods.name: testTags
methods.description: Tests parsing of emoji tags and verifies the tags associated with each emoji.

methods.name: testSkinTones
methods.description: Tests parsing of skin tone modifiers and verifies the ordered skin tones.

methods.name: testDescription
methods.description: Tests parsing of emoji descriptions and verifies the output and base descriptions.
